name: se7enxweb/sqliimport
description: 7x SQLI Import for Exponential: imports content from more than 60 sources (files, feeds, web pages, APIs, SQL and NoSQL databases, other CMS, mailboxes, office documents) through a no-code mapping or import handlers, all in the administration, run by the job queue in chunks with a log and a row per record, on demand, on schedules or by a webhook. Handlers of sqliimport 1.x keep working.

suggest.se7enxweb/expai: The AI assist: suggests mappings and classes, explains failed rows and summarizes runs (off unless enabled)
suggest.ext-pcntl: Lets the 1.x command line script sqlidoimport.php stop safely on SIGTERM or SIGINT
suggest.ext-intl: Slugs and name matching take accents off with Normalizer (a fixed table otherwise)
